title: X2: a documentation correction for a verified build is a rung, not an audit round
summary: From the inbox architecture review (N2); design doc §5.6 X2 and §7.7. Today an inaccurate explanation document of verified code costs a full audit-repair round (tdd, build, audit at deep tier): cycles 1712, 1719 and 1731. The auditor persona FAILs on NEEDS_CORRECTION by stated policy because nothing else corrects the document before ship. Today's route for such a FAIL, with no retry adjudicator wired in production, is the first legal retry (retry@tdd): tdd, build and audit all re-run for a document-only defect.
acceptance: A NEEDS_CORRECTION on a build whose code the audit verified triggers one document-only correction before ship (a host rewrite for mechanical claims such as counts and paths, or a builder re-dispatch naming only the document lines), re-reviewed, with no tdd or build re-run and no audit FAIL
A review that names the code still FAILs
The rung is budgeted from config and recorded in the dossier
The auditor persona's until-X2 FAIL sentence (agents/evolve-auditor-reference.md) is removed in the same landing, so NEEDS_CORRECTION reaches the rung instead of a FAIL
